D: James Bond takes on a gold-obsessed villain with a plan for Fort Knox.
P: Serve the drinks when Goldfinger offers Bond a mint julep at his Kentucky stud farm.
S: Buttermilk cornbread cut into bars like gold bullion, served with butter
Golden buttermilk cornbread baked in a tray and cut into gold bar shapes, with honey butter.
Royal St Mark's golf club prawn toasts
the round of golf Goldfinger tries to cheat

Crisp sesame prawn toasts with sweet chilli and lime, alongside smoked salmon on buttered rye with dill and capers, like a 1960s clubhouse spread. Blitz 300g peeled green prawns with a spring onion, grated ginger, 1 egg white, 1 tsp soy and salt. Spread on 4 slices white bread, press into 50g sesame seeds and cut into triangles. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes a side. Butter 4 slices rye, top with 150g smoked salmon, dill and capers and cut into fingers. Serve with sweet chilli sauce mixed with lime juice.
Crab salad with celery, chives and lemon in baby cos lettuce leaves

Chilled sweet crab in a lemony celery and chive mayonnaise, spooned into crisp baby cos leaves and dusted with paprika. Mix 300g crab meat with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, a finely diced celery stick, chopped chives, lemon zest and juice and a pinch of paprika. Spoon into 12 baby cos leaves and serve cold.
M: Seared sirloin in bourbon pepper cream sauce, with roast potatoes
Sirloin seared hard and rested, the pan deglazed with bourbon, cracked pepper and stock, cream added and reduced, served with crisp potatoes roasted in beef dripping.
Goldfinger's Operation Grand Slam on Fort Knox

Buttermilk-brined chicken in a paprika and white pepper crust fried golden as bullion, with smoky honey butter corn on the cob. Soak 1.5kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with 2 tsp salt. Mix 300g flour with 2 tsp paprika and 1 tsp white pepper. Dredge and fry at 165C for 12 to 15 minutes until 74C inside. Boil 4 corn cobs for 6 minutes, then char on a grill. Melt 50g butter with 1 tbsp honey and half a tsp smoked paprika and brush over the corn.
W: Dark chocolate truffles rolled in cocoa and edible gold dust
Dark chocolate melted into hot cream, chilled 3 hours, rolled into balls, dusted in cocoa, then rolled in edible gold lustre until they shine.
K: Bourbon, mint and sugar syrup over crushed ice in a frosted cup
Mint gently pressed with sugar syrup in a metal cup, 60ml bourbon, packed with crushed ice, stirred until frosted, a big mint sprig on top.

s.note: Buttermilk cornbread cut into bars like gold bullion, served with butter
s.how: Mix 200g cornmeal, 150g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 50g sugar, 2 eggs, 300ml buttermilk and 80g melted butter. Bake in a lined 20 by 30cm tin at 200C for 22 minutes, cut into bars and serve with 100g butter beaten with 2 tbsp honey.

s.note: Crab salad with celery, chives and lemon in baby cos lettuce leaves
s.how: Mix 300g crab meat with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, a finely diced celery stick, chopped chives, lemon zest and juice and a pinch of paprika. Spoon into 12 baby cos leaves and serve cold.

m.note: Seared sirloin in bourbon pepper cream sauce, with roast potatoes
m.how: Roast 1kg potatoes in beef dripping or oil at 220C for 45 minutes. Sear 4 sirloins hard and rest. Deglaze with 60ml bourbon and crushed pepper, add 125ml stock and 200ml cream and reduce.

w.note: Dark chocolate truffles rolled in cocoa and edible gold dust
w.how: Heat 150ml cream and pour over 250g chopped dark chocolate. Stir smooth and chill 3 hours. Roll into balls, dust in cocoa, then roll in edible gold lustre until they shine.

d.note: Bourbon, mint and sugar syrup over crushed ice in a frosted cup
d.how: For each drink, gently press 8 mint leaves with 15ml sugar syrup in a metal cup. Add 60ml bourbon, pack with crushed ice and stir until the cup frosts. Top with a big mint sprig. Makes four.
